best_for: Students who enjoy logical thinking and coding
Those interested in data structures and algorithms
BCA.recommended_if: You enjoy problem-solving, coding, and building systems. You want a technical career in IT. You're comfortable with math and logical thinking.
BCA.not_recommended_if: You dislike programming, avoid mathematics, prefer business or creative work, or want roles in management or finance.

best_for: Students interested in business and management
Those wanting to work in corporate management
BBA.recommended_if: You're interested in business, management, or leadership. You enjoy organizing people and resources. You want a career in corporate management or entrepreneurship.
BBA.not_recommended_if: You prefer technical work, dislike soft skills, avoid people management, or want a purely technical career in IT.

best_for: Students interested in accounting and finance
Those pursuing careers in auditing or taxation
BCOM.recommended_if: You're detail-oriented and enjoy numbers. You're interested in accounting, taxation, or financial management. You want a professional career as CA or financial expert.
BCOM.not_recommended_if: You dislike mathematics, prefer creative work, dislike detailed analysis, or want a technical or people-oriented career.

best_for: Professionals aiming for senior management roles
Those preparing for startups or entrepreneurship
MBA.recommended_if: You have 0-3 years work experience and want to advance to senior management. You're interested in strategy, entrepreneurship, or consulting. You're ready for intensive study.
MBA.not_recommended_if: You prefer technical specialization, dislike group projects, avoid leadership roles, or are early in your first job.

best_for: BCA graduates wanting advanced technical skills
Those interested in research or advanced development
Career aspirants in specialized tech roles
MCA.recommended_if: You have strong coding fundamentals (BCA or equivalent). You want specialized technical skills in AI, systems, or advanced development. You enjoy research and complex problems.
MCA.not_recommended_if: You dislike deep technical work, prefer business roles, don't enjoy continuous learning, or want to move away from coding.

MCOM.recommended_if: You have BCOM background and strong accounting knowledge. You want to specialize in advanced finance, taxation, or auditing. You're preparing for CA or similar qualifications.
MCOM.not_recommended_if: You want to leave accounting/finance, dislike detailed analysis, prefer management over technical accounting, or want broader business exposure.
